provider: Indiana Geographic Information Office, Indiana 2023 Imagery ImageServer
measurement_method: Visual roof-zone interpretation against the Purdue FID 266 footprint. The visible light north/main roof and dark south roof zone are distinguished in plan; image is georeferenced to the listed EPSG:3857 extent.
uncertainty: Vertical roof heights, slopes, eaves, facade, and entrance are not recoverable from this vertical orthophoto. Roof-zone boundary is interpreted from imagery and is not a surveyed architectural seam.
